title: Semiclassical Measures and Exceptional Eigenmodes
exact_target: Classify possible eigenfunction limits, quantify approach to equidistribution, and determine whether exceptional eigenmodes can follow exceptional classical measures.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30001924 (OWR-11447-001). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Arbeitsgemeinschaft: Quantum Ergodicity (2011), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2011/49, pp. 2781--2835; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF pages 3--4, printed pages 2783--2784.
current QUE survey; reference in the saved dated catalogue literature review.

status_qualification: The report ranges over several quantized systems and highlights Laplace eigenfunctions on compact negatively curved manifolds. It does not claim that every invariant measure is realizable for every system; arithmetic joint eigenbases and unqualified Laplace eigenbases are different cases. Classification, rates, and exceptional modes are separate retained requests.
